integrity: All claims in this record concern the stated mathematical model. The included finite numerical checks do not constitute an infinite-dimensional proof. Same-model mathematical review only; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: The sharp envelope is for two unit-modulus pure modulation generators on the full integer Fourier lattice, real phase with absolute value below one half; frame failure/incompleteness is established for absolute phase between one half and one using a one-sided partition. The qualitative cutoff is classical via Kadets, not asserted original. Older exact quantitative estimates might overlap; independent publication-priority review remains outstanding.
title: Sharp universal Riesz bounds for binary-modulated Fourier weavings
